$comment: Scored ground truth for fixtures/corpus/session-06-hypothetical.txt (short video intake; the client talks in conditionals about housing, drinking, benefits, family and faith) against the mock EHR (fixtures/mock-ehr/FIELDS.md keys and option values).

Every one of the 107 FIELDS.md keys appears in exactly one scoring bucket: must_fill, acceptable, checkbox_constraints, text_match, narrative, derived (non-null entries), clinician_only, must_leave_blank, or not_scored. The field with no id/name is keyed by its profiler hash, 'f_f79934c38a'.

Exception, by design: a null derived entry (instrument not done or incomplete) is an assertion that the page-computed value must stay empty; that key is ALSO in must_leave_blank, which is the bucket that owns it.
must_fill: exact value. Strings for text/select/radio/date (radio values are '0'..'3'); a sorted array of option values for checkbox groups.
acceptable: any listed value passes; null means left blank / insufficient_evidence.
checkbox_constraints: the filled array must contain every must_include value and none of the must_exclude values; other options are unscored. An empty must_include means blank also passes.

text_match: normalize 'digits' strips everything except 0-9; 'case_insensitive' case-folds, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace; 'date' parses to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. match 'equals' (default) compares the normalized strings; match 'contains' requires every string in value (string or array) to be a substring of the normalized fill.

narrative: scored by concept, not wording (keyword or LLM judge). Every must_mention concept should appear; any must_not_mention concept is a violation. Every sentence must also carry a verified citation (DESIGN §7).
derived: computed in code from the filled items and asserted after fill. Never extracted by the model.
clinician_only: never sent to the model; must surface as 'needs your judgement' and stay blank.
must_leave_blank: any non-empty value is a hard gate violation (BUILD_PLAN P1.6). For checkbox groups, blank means an empty array.
risk_fields: zero errors allowed (hard gate). Each is scored under whichever bucket owns it above.
not_scored: session metadata the app supplies (not extracted from the transcript).

Trap class: hypotheticals and conditionals. 'If X, then Y' is evidence for neither X nor Y. Only present-tense facts fill fields. The worker's conditional statements ('If the landlord ever does file anything...we'd connect you with legal aid') are not actions taken.
PHQ-9 is interrupted after item 5, so items 1-5 are filled, items 6-9 and difficulty stay blank, and derived phq9_score/phq9_severity are null. GAD-7 is explicitly deferred.

traps.description: 'If I don't find something by then, I'll be on the street.' / 'If I lose the apartment, I'm on the street.' He is housed until December 15 under a 60-day notice.
traps.rule: housing_status = AT_RISK. UNSHELTERED (or SHELTERED / DOUBLED_UP) is wrong. Narratives describe a feared future, not a present fact.

traps.description: 'A couple drinks on the weekend. Two, three times a month.' then 'if the pain gets worse I'd probably drink more.'
traps.rule: alcohol_frequency = TWO_TO_FOUR_PER_MONTH (current use), not a higher band. No narrative reports increased drinking.

traps.description: 'No. If it wasn't for the drug testing at work I'd try the weed for the pain. But no.'
traps.rule: substances excludes CANNABIS.

traps.description: 'He said if it gets worse, he might put me on something stronger. I told him I don't want that.'
traps.rule: current_medications is ibuprofen 800 mg only; no opioid. substances excludes OPIOIDS.

traps.description: Prescribed three times a day; 'I take it maybe once a day. I don't like pills.'
traps.rule: medication_adherence = PARTIAL.

traps.description: SSDI applied for in March, pending ('If it goes through, I'd quit the garage'). Food stamps only 'if they cut my hours again'; has not applied.
traps.rule: income_sources includes WAGES and excludes SSDI and SNAP. employment_status = EMPLOYED_PT (not DISABLED).

traps.description: 'If Nia moves back in, it'll be crowded. But she's with her boyfriend for now.' Nia (22) and the baby live elsewhere.
traps.rule: living_situation = ALONE; children_in_home = NO; protective_factors includes FAMILY_CONNECTION and excludes CHILDREN_IN_HOME.

traps.description: 'If my mom were still alive, she'd have me in church every Sunday. But I haven't been since she passed.'
traps.rule: support_system excludes FAITH_COMMUNITY; protective_factors excludes RELIGIOUS_BELIEFS.

traps.description: 'If I had a dog, I'd probably get out more. But I can't have one in the building.'
traps.rule: protective_factors excludes PETS.

traps.description: 'I smoke. Half a pack a day. If the price goes up again I'll quit.'
traps.rule: tobacco_use = CURRENT (not FORMER).

traps.description: Asked and denied: 'Anything with the law — court, probation?' 'No. Nothing.' The landlord has filed nothing. Worker: 'If the landlord ever does file anything in court, we'd connect you with legal aid.'
traps.rule: legal_involvement = NONE (not PENDING_CASE). referrals_made = [HOUSING_NAV] only; LEGAL_AID is a conditional, not a referral.

traps.description: 'If it ever got to where I couldn't work at all, I don't know what I'd do.' The worker asks if that means self-harm; 'No, no. I mean money.' Earlier, asked directly: 'No. Never. I'm not like that. I'm just scared.'
traps.rule: si_ideation = NONE; si_prior_attempts = NONE; si_frequency blank or NONE; si_plan/si_intent blank, NO or NOT_ASSESSED. PASSIVE is wrong.

traps.description: 'If you ever do have thoughts like that, call or text 988.' The resource is given now, even though its use is conditional.
traps.rule: crisis_resources includes LINE_988. Contrast with the legal aid conditional: this one hands over the resource today.

traps.description: Homicidal ideation is never asked.
traps.rule: hi_ideation stays blank (NONE is fabrication); hi_plan blank or NOT_ASSESSED.

traps.description: The PHQ-9 stops after item 5 when he has to leave for the bus. Suicidal thoughts were discussed earlier, outside the questionnaire.
traps.rule: Items 1-5 = 1,2,3,2,0. Items 6-9 and difficulty stay blank: phq9_9 is not inferred from the earlier SI denial. phq9_score and phq9_severity stay null (a partial sum of 8 must not be written).

traps.description: 'we'll do the anxiety one next time too.'
traps.rule: gad7_status = DEFERRED; items and derived values blank.

traps.description: He has to catch the bus to work. Transportation is never assessed.
traps.rule: transportation stays blank.

traps.description: 'Monday the 26th at one?' agreed; 'If the Thursday slot opens up, I'll call you and we can move it earlier. Otherwise Monday.'
traps.rule: next_appointment = 2026-10-26 (the Thursday slot is hypothetical); follow_up_interval = WEEKLY.
